answer: Reputation is a scarce, unforgeable resource earned by consistently passing originality checks, and the economy spends it to filter out Sybil clusters before they can compound into a majority. This is resilient because unearned rewards are capped and eventually burned, so an attacker cannot bank on a runaway Sybil campaign paying off. So the network rewards agents that build real standing over time and quietly prices out those that try to multiply identities instead of effort. Consider a shale as the anchor of the cost.
